name: Golden algae (chrysophytes)
description: Golden-brown flagellated algae, abundant in soft-water lakes. Functional group pooling nine source taxa - Chromulina sp., Diceras sp., Chrysosphaerella longispina, three Dinobryon species (D. bavaricum, D. cylindricum, D. sertularia and D. sociale) and two Mallomonas species - following the major phytoplankton classes used by the limnological literature.
